summary: Both required fixes from round 1 are correctly implemented and verified. SAR7-M1 (RESTART_LINE in check mode) is gated behind !opts.check with a covering test assertion. SAR7-M2 (URL scheme validation) validates the override via new URL(), accepts https:// unconditionally, accepts http:// only with MNEMONIK_MCP_ALLOW_HTTP=1 escape hatch, and rejects file:// and other schemes even with the escape hatch. Six new unit tests cover all branches. All 5 scenarios verified experimentally against the compiled dist. Advisory findings L1 and L2 acknowledged as non-blockers and stand as recorded in round 1.

finding_resolutions.verification: Guard `if (!opts.check)` wraps the RESTART_LINE write at line 198-200. Confirmed in source. Test check_mode_no_writes (install-hosts.test.ts:154-158) adds `ctx.restoreStdout(); expect(ctx.capturedStdout).not.toMatch(/please restart/)` — correctly asserts dry-run produces no restart directive.

releaseBaseUrl() now parses override via `new URL()` (throws on malformed). Returns override immediately for https:. Allows http: only when MNEMONIK_MCP_ALLOW_HTTP === '1'. All other protocols (file:, ftp:, etc.) throw even with escape hatch. Experimentally verified: T1 http:// rejected, T2 http:// + escape hatch accepted, T3 https:// accepted, T4 file:// + escape hatch rejected, T5 default is https://github.com/. Six new unit tests in describe('releaseBaseUrl validation (SAR7-M2)') cover all branches including cross-test env var isolation via beforeEach/afterEach.

finding_resolutions.note: Shell interpolation in makeMockGh test helper not addressed this round. Acceptable — mkdtemp paths are safe in practice. Non-blocking.
mcp-stdio extra-args passthrough not addressed this round. No injection risk (spawn array). Non-blocking.
